verdict: Nucor's sales jumped 32% to $11.2B and earnings more than doubled to $1.32B ($5.80 a share), as steel prices and volumes rose together across its mills and products businesses.

segments.name: Net sales
segments.note: All steel and steel-products sales — Nucor does not split net sales by segment in its earnings release. By pre-tax earnings, steel mills contributed $1,788M, steel products $465M and raw materials $105M, with corporate/eliminations at -$491M. Nucor shipped 7,533 thousand tons to outside customers at an average of $1,493 per ton, up 19% YoY.

opex.name: Marketing, administrative & other
opex.note: Selling steel and running the company — up from $300M a year ago as volumes and prices rose.

opex.name: Losses & impairments of assets
opex.note: Write-downs and losses on assets this quarter (there were none a year ago).

otherDetail: Other expense of $152M, net: $154M of earnings belonging to noncontrolling partners in Nucor's joint ventures and $7M of net interest expense, partly offset by $9M of equity earnings from part-owned affiliates — so the flow lands on the $1,319M attributable to Nucor stockholders.

takeaways.title: The mills did the heavy lifting
takeaways.text: Steel mills' pre-tax earnings more than doubled to $1,788M from $793M, and steel products earnings rose to $465M from $319M, on higher volumes and higher realized prices. Raw materials earnings were $105M.

takeaways.title: Prices and volumes rose together
takeaways.text: Nucor's average sales price was $1,493 per ton, up 19% from a year ago, and it shipped 7,533 thousand tons to outside customers. Sales rose 32% to $11,249M and net earnings attributable to stockholders rose 117% to $1,319M.

takeaways.title: Cash is piling up
takeaways.text: Nucor generated about $2.7B of free cash flow in the first nine months of 2026 and returned nearly $1.4B to shareholders, ending the quarter with $3.64B of cash and short-term investments and its credit facility undrawn.

footerNote: Nucor reports no operating-income line; the operating-profit step here is net sales minus cost of products sold, marketing/administrative expenses and asset losses/impairments. Net earnings are the $1,319M attributable to Nucor stockholders (total net earnings before noncontrolling interests were $1,473M). Nucor's Q3 is a 13-week quarter ended October 3, 2026, and its earnings release does not split net sales by segment.
